_conforms_to.spec: Anthropic Model Context Protocol tool-schema specification, internal harness scaffolding
_conforms_to.spec_section: MCP tools object per server. The data CONSUMED by these tools (linuxptp daemon state, MachineConfig pool state, NIC PHC counters, kernel driver versions) is O-Cloud-internal platform telemetry, NOT an O-RAN-standardized interface. O-RAN O1 (WG10.TS.O1-Interface) governs SMO-to-managed-element OAM (O-CU, O-DU, O-RU); the O-Cloud platform layer sits below the managed-element boundary. The standardized SMO-facing flow is the O2 IMS Infrastructure Monitoring AlarmEventRecord that the guardrail engine emits downstream.
_conforms_to.schema_role: Declares the tool surface for mcp-platform, the FastMCP server exposing ptp4l, driver, and host configuration tools to the Platform Domain Agent.

server_role: platform-side diagnostic tools for the Platform Domain Agent

tools.name: get_ptp4l_status
tools.description: Returns current linuxptp daemon state, master offset samples, and PTP lock state for the named interface.

tools.name: list_active_services
tools.description: Lists active systemd services on a node, with a filter for known PTP-interfering services (fw-lldp-agent, NetworkManager-dispatcher hooks, custom timing daemons).

tools.name: get_driver_info
tools.description: Returns the loaded kernel module name, version, firmware version, and any known-issue matches for the named interface.

tools.name: get_nic_stats
tools.description: Returns ethtool-style NIC counters relevant to PTP and hardware timestamping (tx_hwtstamp_timeouts, rx_hwtstamp_filter_drops) plus SR-IOV VF allocation status.
